x-m-m1-10.title: Frequency hombe zvinoreva kuti vakaita zvakanaka here?
x-m-m1-10.goal: Dzidza dambudziko rekuenzanisa ma frequencies sezvaakaita kana makirasi maviri aine huwandu hwakasiyana hwevadzidzi, uye usiyanise zvinogona kutaurwa nechokwadi netebhura nezvisingagoneke.
x-m-m1-10.material:
Kirasi 1 (vadzidzi 20) neKirasi 2 (vadzidzi 50) vakatora ongororo yemath imwechete. Frequency distribution table ine ma scores akapatsanurwa kuita ma intervals matatu i seiyi.
Interval / Kirasi 1 (vadzidzi 20) / Kirasi 2 (vadzidzi 50)
Pasi pe 60 points / vadzidzi 2 / vadzidzi 10
60 points kana kupfuura asi pasi pe 80 points / vadzidzi 10 / vadzidzi 25
80 points kana kupfuura / vadzidzi 8 / vadzidzi 15
Minji akati, "Kune vadzidzi vakawanda ve 80 points kana kupfuura muKirasi 2, 15, saka Kirasi 2 yakaita zvirinani muongororo."

x-m-m1-10.s.s1.hint.0: Kune kirasi imwe neimwe, govanisa huwandu hwevadzidzi mu interval iyoyo nehuwandu hwose hwevadzidzi mukirasi iyoyo.
x-m-m1-10.s.s1.hint.1: Tarisa kana sarudzo ipi neipi ichishandisa ruzivo rusiri mutebhura (sa mean) mumhedziso yayo.
x-m-m1-10.s.s1.o.a: Chikamu chevadzidzi vane pasi pe 60 points muKirasi 2 i ka2 yeicho chiri muKirasi 1
x-m-m1-10.s.s1.r.a: Wakagovanisa nehuwandu hwose hwevadzidzi mukirasi imwe neimwe uye wakaenzanisa zvikamu.
x-m-m1-10.s.s1.r.d: Wakagovanisa nehuwandu hwose hwevadzidzi mukirasi imwe neimwe uye wakaenzanisa zvikamu.

x-m-m1-10.s.s1.o.c: Kune vadzidzi vakawanda ve 80 points kana kupfuura muKirasi 2, saka Kirasi 2 yakaita zvirinani muongororo

x-m-m1-10.s.s1.o.d: Chikamu chevadzidzi ve 80 points kana kupfuura i chakakwirira muKirasi 1 kupfuura muKirasi 2
x-m-m1-10.s.s1.explain: Maererano nezvikamu, kune 80 points kana kupfuura, Kirasi 1 ine 8/20=40% neKirasi 2 ine 15/50=30%, saka Kirasi 1 i yakakwirira; kune pasi pe 60 points, Kirasi 1 ine 2/20=10% neKirasi 2 ine 10/50=20%, saka Kirasi 2 i ka2 yeKirasi 1. Mean haigone kuzivikanwa kubva patebhura ine ma intervals akapatsanurwa, uye mhedziso inoenzanisa huwandu hwevadzidzi chete ine rutsigiro rutete.

x-m-m1-08.title: Kuverenga girafu yekukwirira kwemvura rakagadzirwa nemapoindi

x-m-m1-08.prereq.0: Kuratidza maviri akarongwa semapoindi pa coordinate plane
x-m-m1-08.prereq.1: Kuverenga zvinoreva ma axis akatwasuka nekamira
x-m-m1-08.s.s1.prompt: Pindura mubvunzo pese painoratidzwa mapoindi. Zvakanaka kana kufanotaura kwako kwapfuura kushanduka.
x-m-m1-08.s.s1.hint.0: Enzanisa kuti kukwirira kwemapoindi kunoshanduka zvakadini pese painowedzera nguva ne miniti 1.
x-m-m1-08.s.s1.hint.1: Tarisa kana poindi itsva ichiwirirana nekufanotaura kwako kwapfuura, uye kana isingawirirani, funga kuti unofanira kufunga nyaya ipi.

x-m-m1-08.s.s1.st.0.after: Mapoindi matatu anotevedza mutemo mumwe chete (4 cm paminiti), saka 12 cm pamaminitsi 3 kwakajairika. Asi hazvisi zvechokwadi kusvikira poindi inotevera yaoneka.
x-m-m1-08.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Wakaenderera nemutemo wekukwira 4 cm miniti yega yega.
x-m-m1-08.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Wakafunga kuti mapoindi mashoma. Izvo zvine musoro, asi unogona kuita kufungidzira kubva pamapoindi akapiwa zvino.
x-m-m1-08.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Wakafungidzira kuti kukwirira kunokwira pakarepo nekukurumidza kupfuura pakutanga. Tarisa kana pane humbowo hwezvizvo.
x-m-m1-08.s.s1.st.1.ask: Ungafanotaura kuti kukwirira kunova kwakadini pamaminitsi 6?
x-m-m1-08.s.s1.st.1.after: Kusvika zvino, kufanotaura 24 cm kwakajairika, asi sezvo tisingazivi kukwirira kwetangi, unogonawo kufunga nyaya apo yazara (20 cm).
x-m-m1-08.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Tarisa kana une chikonzero chekufunga kuti inononoka kubva pakukurumidza kwayaikwira.
x-m-m1-08.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Tarisa kana une chikonzero chekufunga kuti kukurumidza kwekukwira kunova nekukurumidza pakarepo.
x-m-m1-08.s.s1.st.2.ask: Tsananguro ipi inogoneka pazvakaitika kubva paminetsi 6 kusvika paminetsi 8?
x-m-m1-08.s.s1.st.2.after: Chokwadi chekuti mapoinzi matatu ane hurefu hwakafanana oga hachigone kugadzirisa chikonzero chimwe chete. Tinoda mamwe ruzivo (kureba kwetangi, kana mvura ichiri kupiwa).
x-m-m1-08.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Kureba kwemvura kunoramba kuchikwira, asi ruler yakaratidza mutengo wakafanana
x-m-m1-08.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Zvakaoma kupa mhosva ruler chete yekuratidza mutengo wakafanana ka3 zvichitevana.
x-m-m1-08.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Tangi yakazara, saka haigone kukwira zvakare
x-m-m1-08.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Wakatarisa tangi kuti uwane chikonzero chekuti kureba hakugone kukwira zvakare.
x-m-m1-08.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Wakafunga chikonzero chakareruka zvikuru chekuti kureba hakuchinji.
x-m-m1-08.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Mvura inobuda nemhando imwechete yainodururwa nayo
x-m-m1-08.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Wakafunga kuti kana huwandu hunopinda nehunobuda hwakaenzana, kureba hakuchinji.
x-m-m1-08.s.s1.st.3.after: Panguva imwe mushure meminetsi 8, mvura inotanga kubuda uye kureba kunodzikira ne 4 cm miniti yega yega. Chikonzero chekuti fungidziro yapfuura (24 cm) yakanga isina kururama chinobatanawo nenyaya iyi.
x-m-m1-08.s.s1.st.3.o.a: Mvura iri kubuda uye kureba kuri kudzikira
x-m-m1-08.s.s1.st.3.r.a: Wakaverenga kuchinja kwekudzikira ne 4 cm miniti yega yega.
x-m-m1-08.s.s1.st.3.r.b: Kureba kwakabva ku 20 kuenda ku 16 kuenda ku 12. Verenga zvakare.
x-m-m1-08.s.s1.st.3.r.c: Kana yazara, kureba kunomira pakureba kwetangi. Hakudzikiri.
x-m-m1-08.s.s1.st.3.o.d: Pane mapoinzi maviri chete, saka hatigone kutaura chinhu
x-m-m1-08.s.s1.st.3.r.d: Kunyange nemapoinzi maviri chete, unogona kusimbisa kuti kureba kwakadzikira.
x-m-m1-08.s.s1.reflect: Nguva imwe neimwe mapoinzi aiwedzerwa, fungidziro netsananguro zvakachinja. Pakutanga takaenderera nemutemo, asi mushure meminetsi 6 mapoinzi akaputsa mutemo. Taura kwakaoma kugadzirisa tsananguro imwe chete nekutarisa mapoinzi chete.
x-m-m1-08.s.s2.prompt: Kana ukabatanidza mapoinzi (8, 20) ne (9, 16) nesegment, unogona kuverenga kureba pamaminetsi 8.5 se 18 cm. Tingavimba nemutengo uyu here? Nyora chikonzero chako.

x-m-m1-08.s.s2.hint.1: Funga nyaya mbiri dzekuti kureba kwemvura kwaigona kufamba sei pakati.

x-m-m1-08.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakapa mamiriro kamwe chete kana kupfuura aigona kuitika pakati here?
x-m-m1-08.s.s2.model.0: Hatina kuyera pakati peminetsi 8 neminetsi 9, saka hatigone kuziva kana i 18 cm pamaminetsi 8.5. Ingave yakaramba iri 20 cm kusvika maminetsi 8 masekonzi 30 wobva wadzikira pakarepo.
x-m-m1-08.s.s2.model.1: Pane mapoinzi maviri chete uye hapana mitengo yakayerwa pakati, saka hatigone kuva nechokwadi kuti i 18 cm. Tinogona kutarisa nekuyera pamaminetsi mapfupi kupfuura miniti 1.
x-m-m1-08.s.s2.model.2: Handigone kuvimba nawo. Mitengo yepakati haina kuyerwa.
x-m-m1-08.s.s2.model.3: Kwete. Mapoinzi epakati haana kuyerwa, saka hatigone kutaura kuti yakachinja nemutsetse wakatwasuka.

x-m-m1-03.title: Kuedza chirevo che 'nhamba diki inewo absolute value diki'
x-m-m1-03.goal: Vaka counterexample kugeneralization pamusoro peabsolute values nehurongwa hwehukuru, uye utsvage mamiriro apo inoshanda.
x-m-m1-03.material: Seoyun akati, "Pakati penhamba mbiri, diki inewo absolute value diki. 3<7, uye |3|=3 ne |7|=7, saka 3<7, handizvo here?" (|a| inoverengwa 'absolute value ye a,' uye ndiyo distance pakati pe0 ne a panumber line.)
x-m-m1-03.prereq.0: Nzvimbo dzeintegers nerational numbers panumber line
x-m-m1-03.s.s1.prompt: Gadzira mienzaniso inopikisa chirevo chaSeoyun uchishandisa nhamba mbiri (a, b) apo a<b asi |a| yakakura kupfuura |b|. Unoda mienzaniso miviri umo chiratidzo che b chakasiyana (positive, 0, negative), seimwe apo b ipositive neimwe apo b inegative.
x-m-m1-03.s.s1.hint.0: Tanga wedza kuti chii chinoitika kana a yakakura kupfuura 0.
x-m-m1-03.s.s1.hint.1: Funga kuti a inofanira kuva padivi pe0 ripi panumber line, wobva wasarudza b.
x-m-m1-03.s.s1.ok.c2: Absolute value ye a yakakura kupfuura absolute value ye b.
x-m-m1-03.s.s1.fail.c2: Absolute value ye a haina kukura kupfuura absolute value ye b.
x-m-m1-03.s.s1.explain: a inofanira kuva negative. Mienzaniso: (−5, 2) ine −5<2 asi |−5|=5>|2|=2, uye (−5, −2) ine −5<−2 asi 5>2. Mienzaniso ine b ipositive neine b inegative zvose zvinogoneka.
x-m-m1-03.s.s1.because.prompt: Sarudza muenzaniso mumwe wawakawana uye utsanangure kuti nei chirevo chaSeoyun chakaipa.
x-m-m1-03.s.s1.because.hint.0: Nyora nhamba mbiri dziri mumuenzaniso wawakasarudza neabsolute values dzadzo mbiri padivi nedivi.
x-m-m1-03.s.s1.because.hint.1: Funga kuti mienzaniso mingani inodiwa kuputsa izwi rekuti 'nguva dzose.'
x-m-m1-03.s.s1.because.selfAssess.0: Mumuenzaniso wawakasarudza, a<b inoshanda chaizvo here?
x-m-m1-03.s.s1.because.selfAssess.1: Wakaratidza kuti hukuru hweabsolute values hunobuda hwakapesana nechirevo chaSeoyun here?
x-m-m1-03.s.s1.because.model.0: Semuenzaniso, −5<2, asi absolute value ye −5, iri 5, yakakura kupfuura absolute value ye2, iri 2, saka chirevo chakaipa. Kunyange counterexample imwe chete inoita kuti 'nguva dzose' ive nhema.
x-m-m1-03.s.s1.because.model.1: −3<−1, asi |−3|=3 ne |−1|=1, saka absolute value haina kudiki. Nokuda kwenyaya iyi, chirevo hachishande.
x-m-m1-03.s.s2.prompt: Tinogona kutaura rinhi kuti 'kana a<b, saka |a|<|b|' inofanira kushanda?
x-m-m1-03.s.s2.hint.0: Sarudza nhamba imwe inokodzera mamiriro esarudzo imwe neimwe, uye utarise kana counterexample yawakagadzira kare ingaoneka pasi pemamiriro iwayo.
x-m-m1-03.s.s2.hint.1: Kana counterexample ingaoneka pasi pemamiriro, haikodzeri 'inofanira kushanda.'
x-m-m1-03.s.s2.o.a: Kana nhamba mbiri dzose dziri negative
x-m-m1-03.s.s2.r.a: Kunhamba negative, kurongeka chaizvo kwakapesana. −5<−2, asi absolute values i5>2.
x-m-m1-03.s.s2.o.b: Kana nhamba mbiri dzose dzi0 kana kupfuura
x-m-m1-03.s.s2.r.b: Wakaona kuti kunhamba dzi0 kana kupfuura, absolute value inhamba pachayo, saka hurongwa hwehukuru hunotamisirwa sezvahwakaita.
x-m-m1-03.s.s2.r.c: Kunyange b ichiva positive, inoputsika kana a inhamba negative iri kure ne0 kupfuura b (−5<2).
x-m-m1-03.s.s2.r.d: Kana a inegative, chirevo dzimwe nguva chinoshanda, seye −2<5, uye dzimwe nguva chinoputsika, seye −5<2, saka hazvisi 'inofanira kushanda.'
x-m-m1-03.s.s2.explain: Kana nhamba mbiri dzose dzi0 kana kupfuura, absolute value inhamba pachayo, saka kurongeka kwakafanana. Kana a inegative, chirevo chinoshanda nemukana munyaya dzimwe seye −2<5, asi chinoputsika munyaya seye −5<2, saka hatigoni kutaura 'inofanira kushanda.'

x-m-m1-04.title: Kugadzirisa kutonga kwechiratidzo kana ruzivo rwuchikura
x-m-m1-04.goal: Gamuchira ruzivo nezvezviratidzo zveproduct nehuwandu hweintegers chidimbu nechidimbu, taura zvechokwadi chete, uye pakupedzisira vaka muenzaniso unogutsa mamiriro.
x-m-m1-04.material: Tichakupa ruzivo nezve integers a ne b chidimbu nechidimbu. Nguva imwe neimwe kana ruzivo rwukakura, sarudza zvaunogona kutaura zvechokwadi chete. (Semuenzaniso, unogona kuedza nhamba dzakakodzera uye ufunge kuti nyaya dzipi dzinogoneka.)
x-m-m1-04.s.s1.prompt: Verenga ruzivo nhanho imwe nenguva, uye usarudze zvaunogona kutaura zvechokwadi kubva paruzivo kusvika zvino.
x-m-m1-04.s.s1.hint.0: Kune sarudzo imwe neimwe, edza kugadzira muenzaniso wenhamba dzaigona kuva dzakaipa.
x-m-m1-04.s.s1.hint.1: Tarisa kuti ruzivo rwenhanho dzekare haruna kupesana nesarudzo iyi.
x-m-m1-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Chii chaunogona kutaura zvechokwadi kubva paruzivo urwu oga?
x-m-m1-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Kana product inegative, hapana nhamba i0 uye nhamba mbiri dzine zviratidzo zvakasiyana. Hatisati taziva kuti ipi ipositive.
x-m-m1-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: a=−2, b=3 inopawo product inegative. Chiratidzo che a hachisati chasarudzwa.
x-m-m1-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Kana imwe i0, product i0. Izvo zvinopikisa ruzivo rwekuti product inegative.
x-m-m1-04.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Kana a=−2, b=5, product inegative asi huwandu hwuri positive.
x-m-m1-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Kana zviratidzo zvakasiyana uye huwandu hwuri positive, iya ipositive iri kure ne0 kupfuura. Tichiri kusaziva kuti ipi ipositive.
x-m-m1-04.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Absolute value yenhamba ipositive yakakura kupfuura absolute value yenhamba negative
x-m-m1-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Wakaverenga kuti ipi inofanira kuva kure ne0 kuti huwandu hwuve positive.
x-m-m1-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Kana negative iri kure ne0 kupfuura, huwandu hunegative.
x-m-m1-04.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Nhamba mbiri dzine absolute value imwe chete
x-m-m1-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Kana makosha akazara akafanana uye zviratidzo zvakasiyana, huwandu ndi 0.
x-m-m1-04.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Kubva paRuzivo 2 oga, hatigoni kuziva kuti a kana b ndiyo yakanaka.
x-m-m1-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Zviratidzo za a ne b ndezvipi?
x-m-m1-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Kana zviratidzo zvakasiyana uye a<b, saka a haina kunaka uye b yakanaka. Kubatanidza izvi neRuzivo 2, tinoziva zvakare kuti |a|<|b|.
x-m-m1-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Kana a<b, saka a idiki. Nhamba yakanaka haigoni kuva diki kupfuura isina kunaka.
x-m-m1-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Wakapfuudzanisa ruzivo rwese rutatu uye ukaderedza nyaya dzinogoneka kuva imwe chete.
x-m-m1-04.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Kutarisa a<b pamwe chete ne 'zviratidzo zvakasiyana' kunosarudza.
x-m-m1-04.s.s1.reflect: Pakutanga, 'zviratidzo zvakasiyana' chete ndicho chaiva chakasimba, asi ruzivo rutsva rwega rwega rwakaderedza nyaya dzinogoneka, uye pakupedzisira zvakasarudzwa kuti a<0<b. Panguva apo kutonga kwako kwakashanduka, taura kuti ruzivo rutsva rupi rwakakushandura.
x-m-m1-04.s.s2.prompt: Tsvaga maviri akasiyana 3 enhamba dzakazara (a, b) anosangana neruzivo rwese 3.
x-m-m1-04.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wasarudza zviratidzo za a ne b, wobva wagadzirisa saizi dzazvo kuti huwandu huve hwakanaka.
x-m-m1-04.s.s2.hint.1: Tsiva nhamba dzawakawana mumamiriro matatu rimwe panguva kuti utarise.
x-m-m1-04.s.s2.ok.c1: Nhamba mbiri dzese ndi nhamba dzakazara.
x-m-m1-04.s.s2.explain: Mhinduro ndimaviri ese enhamba dzakazara apo a isina kunaka, b yakanaka, uye |a|<|b|. Mienzaniso: (−2, 5), (−1, 3), (−4, 9).
